units.source_scale_reason: One fixed anatomical scale per original source matches the existing approximately 204px helmet-to-sole body. Pelvis and planted soles provide registration; no per-pose resizing or deformation.

visual_review.notes: Meridian Lockguards: 48 original action placements across seven clips reviewed in Godot at 128px. Shield/weapon arm articulation, polearm attack recovery, dedicated brace and physical salute, reciprocal eight-pose gait, and full grounded collapse. Excludes two clipped source poses and the repeated support-leg proposal; preserves all originals and provenance.
